name: Field_SceneObject_ConsumeTriggerRecord
summary: One-shot trigger-record loader for a field scene object: clears the +0x298..+0x2B4 state block, and when recordId is not 0xFFFF and its save bit is still unset it copies the four u16 fields of the 8-byte record from dataMgr->f_8FC into +0x298/+0x2A0/+0x2AC/+0x2B0, marks the bit used and returns 1.
evidence: New context: the body matches the established field-trigger facts exactly - the save bit is tested with 0x0066B3B0 on (work+0x24A98)+0x5418, the record comes from 0x0063DCE8(dataMgr, id) and the bit is set with 0x006125F0 - and its callers are the named field handlers Field_Marker_OnEvent, Field_SceneObject_ResetMoveTarget, Field_Gadget_InitAnimState and Field_Gadget_OpenAndReport.

name: maybe_Field_SceneObject_ConsumeTriggerRecordB
summary: Twin of 0x0044C454 on the second state block: clears +0x2C8..+0x2E4, and when the record's save bit is still unset it copies the four u16 fields of the 8-byte record into +0x2C8/+0x2D0/+0x2DC/+0x2E0, marks the bit used and returns 1; otherwise it sets the 'no record' flag at +0x2D0 and returns 0.

The third parameter of the old signature is unused by the body and is dropped.
